content_sections.title: A finished event
content_sections.body_text: Use the past simple for a completed event: I ran home yesterday. Add a clear time word such as yesterday.

content_sections.title: Ask for help
content_sections.body_text: A: Could you help me? B: Yes. I ran to the station yesterday. Clap the syllables in yesterday.
